creditos.mensaje: Thank you very much for playing our game!

monokuma_intro.texto: Well, well. Looks like we have a new participant.
Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Monokuma, your adorable host on this beautiful island.
Welcome to Jabberwock Island. Beautiful, isn't it? Too bad you can't leave.
Here you'll find some very interesting students. Each one has something for you.
But before we begin, I need to officially register you in the e-Handbook.
Tell me... what's your talent, Super Student?
Perfect. Registered in the e-Handbook. Let the show begin!

dialogos.monokuma_talento_duplicado: Wait... another Super {0}? This is getting interesting. Upupupu!
dialogos.monokuma_talento_nuevo: Super {0}! What a... peculiar title. Upupupu!

hiyoko.texto: What are you doing here, klutz?
If you want to pass, prove you have some rhythm.
The bon odori has a sacred order. Every step in its moment.

gundham.texto: Mortal! You have dared enter the domain of the Four Dark Devas.
My four guardians obey an immovable cosmic order.
Huh? You want to understand what I'm talking about?
If you summon them in the correct order... I will consider letting you pass.

chiaki.texto: Every game has a pattern. If you memorize it, you can always win.
I'll show you something. You just have to remember it exactly.

nagito.texto: Oh... I wasn't expecting a visitor. Though luck always finds its way.
Logic is the only true hope, don't you think?
Allow me to ask you a few questions. For someone with hope, they won't be a problem.

monokuma.texto: Upupupu... so you made it this far.
I thought you'd give up. But here you are, with your four hope fragments.
Very well. The exit door has a four-digit code.
Each of my dear students has one digit. Visit them clockwise and you'll get what you need.
Can you figure them all out? Upupupu!

hiyoko_pista.texto: Fine, fine. My number... it's the steps of the first bon odori movement.
One, two, three. Get it, klutz? Three steps. That's my number.

gundham_pista.texto: The Seven Seals of the Abyss were broken by my Four Devas and the Three Ancestral Spirits.
Remember that number. Seven. That is all you need to know.

chiaki_pista.texto: In every game there's a player number one. The first. The one who always starts.
My number is that one. The first. Do you understand?

nagito_pista.texto: Oh... what a coincidence that you returned.
Four hope fragments. Four souls that trusted you.
The answer was always in what you already had. My number is four.

preguntas.pregunta: This being masters the shadows and hunts in absolute silence. Its eyes see what mortals cannot. What creature is it?
The beast that can kill with a single glance according to legend. Its venom can stop the bravest heart. Which is it?
preguntas.pista: It spreads its hood before striking.

preguntas.pregunta: The animal that ancient empires used as a symbol of absolute power and immortality. It is reborn from its own ashes.
What weighs less than a feather, but not even the strongest man in the world can hold it for more than a few minutes?
I am always running but have no legs. I have a face but no eyes. What am I?
We come out at night without being called, and vanish during the day without being stolen. What are we?
